# Joebrown Palace Hotel and Suites

Joebrown Palace Hotel and Suites is a premier luxury destination located in Lagos, offering refined accommodation, gourmet dining, and bespoke concierge hospitality.

## Core Offerings
- **Luxury Rooms**: Standard, Deluxe, Executive Suites, and Penthouse Suites with premium amenities and stylish aesthetics.
- **Restaurant & Lounge**: Freshly prepared Nigerian specialties, pepper soup, grilled meals, savory snacks, fine wines, cognac, and handcrafted cocktails.
- **Smart Hospitality**: Guests can order online directly from their phones using room or table QR codes for 24/7 room delivery or table service.
- **Intercom Hub & Concierge**: Real-time guest request fulfillment.

## Location
Lagos, Nigeria.

## Online Services
Guests can place food and drink orders online at https://joebrownhotels.com/menu for dine-in (room service / table service).
Bookings can be made at https://joebrownhotels.com/rooms
